title: Exam week
blurb: Probability theory, the library, and a message from Beijing.

paragraphs.zh: 下个星期我有一个考试，是概率论。这个考试很难，所以我最近每天都在图书馆复习。
paragraphs.en: Next week I have an exam in probability theory. It's hard, so lately I've been revising in the library every day.

paragraphs.zh: 我做了很多练习，可是有的题我还是不会做。我有点着急。
paragraphs.en: I've done lots of exercises, but there are still some questions I can't do. I'm a bit anxious.

paragraphs.zh: 晚上女朋友给我发了一个信息：“别着急！你学习那么认真，一定没问题。”
paragraphs.en: In the evening my girlfriend sent me a message: "Don't worry! You study so hard, you'll be fine."

paragraphs.zh: 考试那天，我八点就到了。题比我想的容易。
paragraphs.en: On the day of the exam I was there by eight. The questions were easier than I'd thought.

paragraphs.zh: 两个星期以后，成绩出来了。我考得很好！我马上给她打电话。
paragraphs.en: Two weeks later, the results came out. I did really well! I called her straight away.
